label: Chipset
description: Your product as the chip on a circuit board, wired to every partner: a glowing packet runs down each trace in turn and lights the partner's pill. Edit the partner list and the pills re-flow and the traces re-route, one or two rows on a wide canvas, two columns on a phone.

hub.label: Hub
hub.description: The chip's label: your product or company.

partners.label: Partners
partners.description: The partners, one pill each. Wide canvases get one or two rows under the chip, tall ones two columns; every trace re-routes.

hubIcon.label: Hub icon
hubIcon.description: The mark above the hub label: "m0saic" (the M), "none", or an SVG path d drawn in a 24×24 box (a Simple Icons path pastes straight in).

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Glow colour as #rrggbb: packets, lit traces, lit pills.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the board decoration and the order the partners light up in.
